mapper.sql: c.*, u.nickname AS author_nickname, u.avatar AS author_avatar, a.title AS article_title, c.user_id = a.author_id AS article_author
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM blog_site_config WHERE config_key = 'comment' FOR UPDATE
SELECT comment_id, parent_id, status FROM blog_comment WHERE article_id = #{article} AND (comment_id = #{rootId} OR root_id = #{rootId}) ORDER BY comment_id FOR UPDATE

SELECT , ru.nickname AS reply_to_nickname, LEFT(p.content, 120) AS reply_to_content FROM blog_comment c JOIN blog_article a ON a.article_id = c.article_id JOIN sys_user u ON u.user_id = c.user_id LEFT JOIN blog_comment p ON p.comment_id = c.parent_id AND p.article_id = c.article_id LEFT JOIN sys_user ru ON ru.user_id = p.user_id WHERE c.article_id = #{article} AND c.comment_id IN
#{id}
ORDER BY c.create_time, c.comment_id
ORDER BY c.create_time DESC, c.comment_id DESC

SELECT c.*, CASE WHEN THEN a.title END AS article_title, CASE WHEN THEN a.slug END AS article_slug FROM blog_comment c JOIN blog_article a ON a.article_id = c.article_id
ORDER BY c.create_time DESC, c.comment_id DESC
